info.title: UM-B4 Center Management API
info.description: Same-process isolated admin-plane API. It is served on the admin listener only (/api/v1/*), never on the agent ingest listener. Authentication is a local, operator-owned bearer token file; roles/event scopes are resolved server-side. UM-C login/TOTP/session/Cloudflare is not implemented here.
